notes.title: We've launched a Patreon!
notes.content:
As some of you may know, we struggled to fund the development of [i]Echoes of the Fey: The Last Sacrament[/i], and our attempt at Kickstarter didn't pan out. We managed to cross the finish line, but it was a hard journey! So as we forge ahead with our next project, we've decided to try something different. [url=https://www.patreon.com/woodsy_studio]We've launched a Patreon![/url]

[url=https://www.patreon.com/woodsy_studio][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31856198/3c7f74cfee995630738a741102f6258497fb3215.jpg[/img][/url]

We've already posted our first piece of custom content for patrons: a new CG of Michael and Lucifer from [i]miraclr - Divine Dating Sim[/i].

Funds from Patreon will help us develop our next game, Crimson Spires, a blend of otome romance and horror (hint: there will be vampires). Meanwhile, patrons will see art, screenshots, and game development posts before we post them anywhere else. 

[url=https://www.patreon.com/woodsy_studio][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31856198/bc33062a542a277f7735ba9f6d21db0d6f12a29c.jpg[/img][/url]

One way or another, thanks for playing our games and we hope you continue to enjoy our work. Your support encourages and enables us to keep creating!

<3 Jenny and Malcolm

notes.title: Minor update: Tavern investigation
notes.content: Hello everyone! We pushed an update today with a fix for an error in an optional scene with Anya in which the questions didn't navigate correctly. That scene should now run as expected.

notes.title: Released!
notes.content:
The day has arrived; we are now released!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32789057/a5396db9a408e4b295acd8dcf70f79d0a37aef44.jpg[/img]

The soundtrack is also available as DLC, and both of them will be 10% off the first week of release. 

We have worked hard to give you all a game with lots of drama, romance, and high quality storytelling. Thanks to the power of the UE4 engine, we've added 3D camera views and other cinematic effects to the traditional visual novel elements. You can also play the mini-game, RiftRealms, to get new insights on the world and its characters. We sincerely hope you enjoy this game, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts!

-- Jenny and Malcolm

notes.title: Releasing July 10
notes.content:
Greetings everyone! We're so excited to share this game with you. Primary production on the game is complete, but we're using the time until release to get as much quality assurance on the game as possible and add extra features. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32789057/0d76b1a9ff1b47458b380fca29b050fb26e7034c.jpg[/img]

To ensure we're giving you the best game possible, we're pushing the release date to [b]July 10[/b]. This will allow us to add features like a gallery of unlockable images to the game, as well as a repeatable RiftRealms game you can play at any time.  

See you then!
